name: Quartus
title: Christian brother in Corinth
summary: Quartus was a Christian in Corinth mentioned briefly in Paul's letter to the Romans. He sends his greetings along with other believers and is called 'our brother,' indicating his belonging to the church.

keyEvents.title: Greetings to the Church in Rome
keyEvents.description: Quartus is mentioned as 'our brother' when he sends his greetings to the Christians in Rome through Paul's letter. This shows his connection to the early Christian community in Corinth.
